summary: Playwright networkidle timeout eliminated. Tests execute without infrastructure timeout.

root_cause.original_issue: waitForLoadState('networkidle') never completes due to Firebase/analytics persistent connections
root_cause.fix_applied: Replaced networkidle with domcontentloaded + element-based waits + Firebase route blocking
root_cause.remaining_blocker: Login bypass not working - tests redirect to login page, login credentials work but route blocking also blocks Firebase auth

changes: Added VITE_STUB_EXTRACTION=true to webServer build command

commands_run.result: 3 tests ran, 3 failed with assertion errors (NOT timeout)
commands_run.evidence: Tests execute in ~30s without networkidle timeout

fix_summary: Replaced waitForLoadState('networkidle') with element-based waits (domcontentloaded + data-testid selectors). Added Firebase/analytics route blocking. Tests now execute and fail on real assertions (login redirect issue) instead of infrastructure timeout.
why_networkidle_wrong: Firebase/Firestore maintains persistent WebSocket connections and analytics services poll continuously. The page is fully interactive long before network goes 'idle'. Using networkidle causes indefinite waiting.
next_actions: Fix route blocking to allow Firebase Auth while blocking Firestore/analytics
OR: Use Playwright auth state storage to avoid re-login per test
